title: confirm_document_checked output
description: The response envelope. On success, data is the write result for the Document Link (O19), with the new status, Last Checked On and staleOn.
$comment: WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 9). For a document type with Current Needs Person = yes (C22), current from an AI client is stored as draft until the person confirms on a confirmation card.

data.description: The write result for the Document Link (O19).

status.description: Current or stale after the check. Draft while a confirmation card is out.

staleOn.description: When the document becomes stale next. Null when it is stale or draft.

confirmationCardSent.$comment: WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 9). For a document type with Current Needs Person = yes (C22), current from an AI client is stored as draft until the person confirms on a confirmation card.
confirmationCardSent.description: True when a confirmation card went to the person, because an AI client asked for current on a document type with Current Needs Person = yes. The link stays draft until the person confirms. False when validateOnly was true.

examples.summary: The design notes are confirmed as still true until May 2027.
